paper_title: Gated Attention for Large Language Models Non-linearity, Sparsity, and   Attention-Sink-Free
caption: Comparison of massive activations and attention sink phenomena across different gating configurations. Row 1 (Baseline): Significant massive activations and attention sinks emerge after the 6th layer. Row 2 (SDPA Gating): Reduced activations and no attention sinks observed. Row 3 (Value Layer Gating): Similar activations to Row 2 but with residual attention sinks. Rows 4–5 (Reduced Sparsity via cross-head share and NS-sigmoid): Massive activations and attention sinks resemble the baseline.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: Тази линейна диаграма илюстрира промяната на максималната активационна стойност по слоеве за различни компоненти в базовата архитектура на езиков модел, като целта е да се визуализира явлението „massive activation“ и „attention sink“ в първия ред на сравнението. Оста X е означена като „Layer“ и представлява номера на слоя, с линейна скала, обхващаща диапазона от 0 до 22, с етикети на всеки 5 слоя (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). Оста Y е означена като „Max Activation Value“ и измерва максималната активационна стойност на даден слой, с линейна скала от 0 до 1600, с етикети на интервали от 200 (0, 200, 400, ..., 1600). На графиката са представени четири линии: „attn_output“ (синя пунктирана линия), „attn_residual“ (оранжева точкована линия), „ffn_output“ (зелена пунктирана линия) и „ffn_residual“ (червена плътна линия). Линията „ffn_residual“ започва с ниска стойност около 0 до слой 5, след което рязко се издига до около 1400 при слой 6, остава на ниво около 1500 до слой 20, след което спада рязко до около 400 при слой 22. Линията „attn_residual“ следва подобен, но по-мек профил — започва от 0, се издига до около 1400 при слой 6, остава на ниво около 1500 до слой 20, след което спада до около 200 при слой 22. Линията „ffn_output“ започва от 0, достига връх около 1300 при слой 6, спада до 0 до слой 12, след което се вдига отново до около 1200 при слой 22. Линията „attn_output“ остава близо до 0 до слой 20, след което се издига до около 300 при слой 22. Всички линии показват значително нарастване на активациите след слой 5, което съответства на описанието за „massive activation“ и „attention sink“ в първия ред на сравнението.
model_annotations.Chinese: This line chart, titled “Massive Activation of baseline,” illustrates the maximum activation values across layers for four distinct components within a baseline model configuration: attn_output, attn_residual, ffn_output, and ffn_residual. The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” spans from 0 to approximately 23 with linear scaling and integer tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled “Max Activation Value,” ranges from 0 to 1600 with linear scaling and major tick marks at intervals of 200. The attn_output (blue dashed line) remains near zero until layer 21, then sharply rises to approximately 250 by layer 23. The attn_residual (orange dotted line) begins near zero, spikes abruptly to 1400 at layer 5, plateaus near 1550 until layer 21, then drops sharply to 300 by layer 23. The ffn_output (green dash-dot line) stays near zero until layer 5, surges to 1400, drops to near zero by layer 7, briefly rises to 100 around layer 13, then returns to near zero until layer 21, after which it spikes to 1200 by layer 23. The ffn_residual (red solid line) remains near zero until layer 5, jumps to 1400, rises slightly to 1550 by layer 13, maintains that level until layer 21, then plunges to 400 by layer 23.
model_annotations.English: The line plot titled “Massive Activation of baseline” illustrates the maximum activation values across 22 model layers for four distinct components: attn_output (blue dashed line), attn_residual (orange dotted line), ffn_output (green dash-dot line), and ffn_residual (red solid line). The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” spans from 0 to 22 with integer tick marks at every 5 layers. The y-axis, labeled “Max Activation Value,” ranges from 0 to 1600 with tick marks at intervals of 200. All four lines remain near zero until layer 5, after which they exhibit sharp increases: attn_output rises to ~1200 by layer 6 and then declines; attn_residual peaks at ~1500 by layer 6 and remains high until layer 21 before dropping; ffn_output surges to ~1200 at layer 6, drops to near zero by layer 8, spikes again to ~1200 at layer 13, then falls and rises again to ~1200 at layer 22; ffn_residual jumps to ~1400 at layer 5, plateaus near 1500 through layer 20, then drops sharply to ~400 at layer 22. The plot visually confirms the caption’s claim that the baseline configuration exhibits massive activations and attention sinks emerging after the 6th layer, as evidenced by the sustained high values and abrupt drops across multiple components.
model_annotations.German: The line chart titled “Massive Activation of baseline” plots the maximum activation value across model layers, with the x-axis labeled “Layer” ranging from 0 to approximately 22 in linear increments of 5, and the y-axis labeled “Max Activation Value” ranging from 0 to 1600 in linear increments of 200. Four distinct lines are plotted: “attn_output” (blue dashed line) remains near zero across all layers, with a slight rise to approximately 200 near layer 22; “attn_residual” (orange dotted line) stays near zero until layer 5, then sharply rises to ~1400, plateaus until layer 21, then drops to ~1200 at layer 22; “ffn_output” (green dash-dot line) remains near zero until layer 5, spikes to ~1400, drops sharply to ~100 by layer 7, rises slightly to ~200 at layer 13, then returns to near zero until layer 21, where it spikes again to ~1200 before falling to ~600 at layer 22; “ffn_residual” (red solid line) remains near zero until layer 5, rises sharply to ~1400, plateaus until layer 21, then drops to ~400 at layer 22 before rising again to ~600 at layer 22. All lines exhibit a sharp onset of high activation after layer 5, followed by a decline or fluctuation toward the final layers, with the ffn_residual and attn_residual lines maintaining the highest values over most of the layer range.
